ownerRequest: 把这个模仿真人训练后的模型和029、旧reason各评测1000局，看看胜率有没有提高，结果也放到dashboard上

oldReason.search: 9001 8worlds,6candidates,2networkrollouts; <=20exact solver;50s native reasoning/3s solver; cold each round

rules: 108 physical cards, single complete round, seeded uniform level2..A and leader; no tribute; same deal/level/leader then swap both teams; max1000turns truncation error not draw
policy: Raw029 and imitation both greedy over identical canonical candidates, with immediate legal finish and forced-action shortcut. Imitation logits never used as upgrade values or search leaf values. Old reason is full search plus017 fallback, not its rawbase.
timeBudget: Once-registered3hours each including summary; STOP/deadline checked before and after every action; no extension, reselection or extra games on outcomes.
metrics: Separate W/L/D, winrate and95% deal-pair clusterCI, signed final upgrade mean and95%CI, ranks/doubleup/down; simultaneous97.5%CI for two opponent comparisons. No pooling.
strengthInterpretation: Versus029 directly tests post-training vs initialization. Old-reason result describes this fixed opponent; historical raw029/oldreason rates are different deals and cannot prove causal training gain. No new-champion or website publish authorization.
humanData: None used during evaluation; frozen trained model only. No raw human cards,names,rooms or secrets published.
pipeline: Reuse compare-champion-reason registered controller; add frozen raw-opponent mode; dashboard reads both separate roots; sources and weights frozen before start.
